NAME: Exchange tradable derivative position Protection arrangement assignment
DESCRIPTION: Exchange tradable derivative position Protection arrangement assignment is the combination of Exchange tradable derivative position and Protection arrangement   stating which Exchange tradable derivative position is offering protection for which Protection arrangement.

NAME: Exchange tradable option
DESCRIPTION: An Exchange tradable option is an Exchange tradable derivative in the form of an option.

NAME: Factoring cash reserve
DESCRIPTION: A Factoring cash reserve is a cash reserve of a Factoring transaction. If such a cash reserve is not represented as a collateral it is registered as a Factoring cash reserve.

NAME: Factoring
DESCRIPTION: Factoring is a Trade receivable in which the bank purchases receivables from a business and may advance all or part of the receivables.

NAME: Factor
DESCRIPTION: A Factor is a Party role where the Party provides a Factoring service to an Assigned debtor in a Factoring transaction.

NAME: Fundamental review of the trading book standard approach risk measure for ETD positions
DESCRIPTION: A measured risk of an ETD position against a particular risk factor

NAME: Fundamental review of the trading book standard approach risk measure for security positions
DESCRIPTION: A measured risk of a Security position against a particular risk factor

NAME: Fundamental review of the trading book standard approach risk measure
DESCRIPTION: Fundamental review of the trading book standard approach risk measure is a measured risk of a position against a particular risk factor.

NAME: Fundamental review of the trading book standard approach risk measure for OTC positions
DESCRIPTION: A measured risk of an OTC position against a particular risk factor

NAME: Funds for general banking risk
DESCRIPTION: According to BAD art 38.1; CRR art 4(112); Annex V.Part 2.15.

NAME: Fund security
DESCRIPTION: A Fund security is an Equity and fund security in the form of a Fund.

NAME: Financial asset instrument debtor assessed
DESCRIPTION: A Financial asset instrument debtor assessed is a Potential retail exposure class financial asset instrument where a debtor based approach has been applied to evaluate the Default status.

NAME: Financial asset instrument individually assessed
DESCRIPTION:
A Financial asset instrument individually assessed is a Potential retail exposure class financial asset instrument where a Transaction based assessment of the Detault status has been applied in accordance with Regulation (EU) 575/2013, Article 178 Default of an obligor.
Regulation (EU) 575/2013, Article 178 Default of an obligor:
"In the case of retail exposures, institutions may apply the definition of default laid down in points (a) and (b) of the first subparagraph at the level of an individual credit facility rather than in relation to the total obligations of a borrower.".

NAME: Financial asset instrument
DESCRIPTION:
A Financial asset instrument is an Instrument role where the Instrument acts in the role of a Financial asset (according to the applied accounting standard) where the instrument is intended as an asset, either for the reporting agent or for someone else. 
Please note that a Financial asset instrument does not necessarily be recognised in the balance sheet.
Please note too that an instrument can be both an Asset and a Liability at the same time. This can happen, for example, when a debtor overpays the fees and/or installments.

NAME: Financial collateral
DESCRIPTION: Financial collateral is Collateral in the form of a financial asset.

NAME: Originator
DESCRIPTION:
Regulation (EU) 2402/2017, Article 2(3):
‘Originator’ means an entity which: (a) itself or through related entities, directly or indirectly, was involved in the original agreement which created the obligations or potential obligations of the debtor or potential debtor giving rise to the exposures being securitised; or (b) purchases a third party’s exposures on its own account and then securitises them.

NAME: Over the counter (OTC) Credit default swap
DESCRIPTION: An Over the counter (OTC) Credit default swap (CDS) is an Over the counter (OTC) Swap where the Seller of the CDS will compensate the Buyer in a specified (default) event.

NAME: Over the counter (OTC) Credit default swap Collateral received instrument assignment
DESCRIPTION:
Over the counter (OTC) Credit default swap Collateral received instrument assignment is the combination of Over the counter (OTC) Credit default swap and Collateral received instrument that indicates which Over the counter (OTC) Credit default swap is linked to which Collateral received instrument. 

Because there can be more than one CDS for one instrument, only one can become eligible as a guarantee for that instrument. However, all CDSes are linked here.

NAME: Open repurchase transaction
DESCRIPTION: An Open repurchase transaction is a Repurchase transaction without a specified maturity date.

NAME: Other organisational unit
DESCRIPTION: An Other organisational unit is an Organisational unit that is not a Branch or an Investment vehicle / fund.

NAME: Other over the counter (OTC) Derivative instrument
DESCRIPTION: An Other over the counter (OTC) Derivative instrument is an Over the counter (OTC) Derivative instrument that is not an Over the counter (OTC) Swap, Over the counter (OTC) Option or Over the counter (OTC) Forward.

NAME: Over the counter (OTC) Option other than Over the counter (OTC) Credit spread option
DESCRIPTION: Over the counter (OTC) Option other than Over the counter (OTC) Credit spread option is an Over the counter (OTC) Option that is not an Over the counter (OTC) Credit spread option.

NAME: Other over the counter (OTC) Swap
DESCRIPTION: An Other over the counter (OTC) Swap is an Over the counter (OTC) Swap that is not an Over the counter (OTC) Total return swap or an Over the counter (OTC) Credit default swap.

NAME: Other overnight deposit
DESCRIPTION: An Other overnight is an Overnight deposit that is not a Transferable deposit.

NAME: Other party code
DESCRIPTION: Other party code is a Party code that is not a RIAD code nor an LEI.

NAME: Other party identifier
DESCRIPTION: Other party identifier is a code (different to the attribute Party identifier) of a Party that identifies the party in systems outside of the bank. It is a combination of a Party and a Party  identifier type.

NAME: Other provision
DESCRIPTION: A Other provisions is a Provision that is not Funds for general banking risk, Employee benefit, Resturcturing and Pending legal issues and tax litigation.

NAME: Other trade receivable
DESCRIPTION: An Other trade receivable is a Trade receivable other than Factoring.

NAME: Overnight deposit
DESCRIPTION:
An Overnight deposit is a Deposit fulfilling definition of Regulation (EU) 1071/2013, Annex 2, Part 2 Definitions of instrument categories, Table Instrument categories, 9.1 Overnight deposits:
Deposits which are convertible into currency and/or which are transferable on demand by cheque, banker’s order, debit entry or similar means, without significant delay, restriction or penalty. This item includes: 
(a) balances (interest-bearing or not) which are immediately convertible into currency on demand or by close of business on the day following that on which the demand was made, without any significant penalty or restriction, but which are not transferable; (b) balances (interest-bearing or not) representing prepaid amounts in the context of ‘hardware-based’ or ‘software-based’ e-money, e.g. prepaid cards; 
(c) loans to be repaid by close of business on the day following that on which the loan was granted.

NAME: Physical collateral
DESCRIPTION: Physical collateral is Collateral that is a material non-financial collateral.

NAME: Payment agent
DESCRIPTION:
Payment agent is a party role, where the party is fulfilling the duties of the payment agent in a syndicated loan or sub-participation. 

 It has to be reported to the ECB as a second servicer for the loan in certain circumstances.

NAME: Pending legal issues and tax litigation
DESCRIPTION: According to IAS 37.Appendix C. Examples 6 and 10.

NAME: Pension and other post-employment defined benefit obligation
DESCRIPTION: According to IAS 19.63; IAS 1.78(d); Annex V.Part 2.9.

NAME: Prudential consolidation group
DESCRIPTION: A Prudential consolidation group is an Internal consolidation group according to Capital Requirements Regulation (CRR), Part 1, Title II, Chapter 2, Section 2.

NAME: Performing debt security
DESCRIPTION: Performing debt security is a debt security that is classified performing.

NAME: Performing financial asset instrument debtor assessed
DESCRIPTION: A Performing financial asset instrument debtor assessed is a Financial asset instrument debtor assessed that is classified as performing according to FINREP, Annex V, part 2 (213)-(239).

NAME: Renegotiated credit facility with forbearance measure
DESCRIPTION: A Renegotiated credit facility with forbearance measure is a Renegotiated credit facility where forbearance measures have been applied.

NAME: Renegotiated debt security
DESCRIPTION: A Renegotiated debt security  is a debt security where a renegotiation has occured.

NAME: Renegotiated debt security without forbearance measure
DESCRIPTION: A Renegotiated debt security without forbearance measure is a Renegotiated debt security  where no forbearance measure have been applied.

NAME: Renegotiated debt security with forbearance measure
DESCRIPTION: A Renegotiated debt security with forbearance measure is a Renegotiated debt security where forbearance measures have been applied.

NAME: Renegotiated financial asset instrument
DESCRIPTION: A Renegotiated financial asset instrument is a Financial asset instrument where a renegotiation has occured.

NAME: Credit facility Creditor assignment
DESCRIPTION: A Credit facility Creditor assignment is a Credit facility Entity role assignment where the Entity role is Creditor.

NAME: Credit facility Debtor assignment
DESCRIPTION: A Credit facility Debtor assignment is a Credit facility Entity role assignment where the Entity role is Debtor.

NAME: Credit facility Entity role assignment
DESCRIPTION: A Credit facility Entity role assignment is the combination of a Credit facility and an Entity role that indicates which Entity role is assigned to which Credit facility.

NAME: Credit facility with interest rate
DESCRIPTION: A Credit facility with interest rate is a Credit facility that comprises an interest rate.

NAME: Credit facility
DESCRIPTION:
A Credit facility is a commitment (revocable or irrevocable) made by a financial institution to make an amount of money available to the customer (or a plurality of customers), or to assume for it an obligation to a third party. The commitment is based on an agreement between the financial institution and the customer, which originates from a request of the customer or an acceptance by the customer of a proposal from the financial institution.

Please note that the Credit facility is always off-balance sheet given.

NAME: Credit facility other than under pre-specified terms and conditions
DESCRIPTION: A Credit facility other than under pre-specified terms and conditions is a type of credit facility that is not  under pre-specified terms and conditions.

NAME: Credit facility risk data
DESCRIPTION: Credit facility risk data is risk related information about a Credit facility.

NAME: Credit facility Servicer assignment
DESCRIPTION: A Credit facility Servicer assignment is a Credit facility Entity role assignment where the Entity role is Servicer.

NAME: Credit facility under pre-specified terms and conditions
DESCRIPTION: A Credit facility under pre-specified terms and conditions is a type of credit facility that is under pre-specified terms and conditions.

NAME: Credit institution
DESCRIPTION: Credit institution is an undertaking the business defined in Regulation (EU) 575/2013, Article 4 (1)(1).

NAME: Credit risk mitigation arrangement
DESCRIPTION: A Credit risk mitigation arrangement is a Protection arrangement that is not a Collateral annex.

NAME: Credit risk mitigation assignment
DESCRIPTION:
A credit risk mitigation membership is the combination of a Credit risk mitigation arrangement and a Protection item that indicates which Protection item is comprised in which Credit risk mitigation arrangement. 
Please note that the many-to-many relationship (established via this entity) is only applicable to Registered protection (and saving accounts where there exists a physical document (i.e. Sparbuch)), for all other Protection items the relationship between the Credit risk mitigation arrangement and the Protection item is of type one-to-many.

NAME: Non-balance sheet recognised security position
DESCRIPTION: A non-balance sheet recognised security position is a security position that is not recognised in the balance sheet. A security position that is not recognised in the balance sheet is by default a long security position.

NAME: Non-balance sheet recognised security position national general accepted accounting principles (nGAAP) fiduciary item
DESCRIPTION: Non-balance sheet recognised security position national general accepted accounting principles (nGAAP) fiduciary item is a Non-balance sheet recognised security position where the applicable accounting standard is national GAAP and that is fiduciary

NAME: Non-central government rating system
DESCRIPTION: A Non-Central government rating system is an Issuer based rating system where the Issuer is not a Central government.

NAME: Non-default financial asset instrument individually assessed
DESCRIPTION: A Non-default financial asset instrument individually assessed is a Financial asset instrument individually assessed that is not classified as defaulted according to Regulation (EU) 575/2013, Article 178.

NAME: Trade receivable collateral
DESCRIPTION: Trade receivable collateral is a Financial collateral that adheres to the definition of Trade receivable in paragraph 85(c) of part 2 of Annex V to the amended Implementing Regulation (EU) No 680/2014.

NAME: Trade receivable
DESCRIPTION:
A Trade receivable is a Loan fulfilling the definition of Annex V, Party 2.85(c):
‘Trade receivables’ shall include loans to other debtors granted on the basis of bills or other documents that give the right to receive the proceeds of transactions for the sale of goods or provision of services. This item shall include all factoring and similar transactions, like acceptances, outright purchase of trade receivables, forfaiting, discounting of invoice, bills of exchange, commercial papers and other claims where the reporting institution buys the trade receivables (both with and without recourse);

NAME: Over the counter (OTC) Credit spread option
DESCRIPTION: A Credit spread option (also known as a "credit spread") is an options contract that includes the purchase of one option and the sale of a second similar option with a different strike price. Effectively, by exchanging two options of the same class and expiration, this strategy transfers credit risk from one party to another.

NAME: Over the counter (OTC) Derivative Buyer assignment
DESCRIPTION: An Over the counter (OTC) Derivative Buyer assignment is the combination of an Over the Counter (OTC) Derivative and a Buyer that indicates which Buyer buys which Over the counter (OTC) Derivative.

NAME: Over the counter (OTC) Derivative as a hedge
DESCRIPTION: An Over the counter (OTC) Derivative as a hedge is an Over the counter (OTC) Derivative role where the Over the counter (OTC) Derivative instrument acts as a hedge.

NAME: Over the counter (OTC) Derivative as a hedge according to International Financial Reporting Standard (IFRS)
DESCRIPTION: Over the counter (OTC) Derivative as a hedge according to International Financial Reporting Standard (IFRS) is an Over the counter (OTC) Derivative as a hedge where the applicable accounting standard is IFRS.

NAME: Over the counter (OTC) Derivative as a hedge according to national general accepted accounting principles (nGAAP)
DESCRIPTION: Over the counter (OTC) Derivative as a hedge according to national general accepted accounting principles (nGAAP) is an Over the counter (OTC) Derivative as a hedge where the applicable accounting standard is nGAAP.

NAME: Over the counter (OTC) Derivative instrument Collateral given assignment
DESCRIPTION: A Over the counter (OTC) Derivative instrument Collateral given assignment is the combination of a Over the counter (OTC) Derivative instrument and a Collateral given that indicates which Over the counter (OTC) Derivative instrument is assigned to which Collateral.

NAME: Over the counter (OTC) Derivative instrument derived data
DESCRIPTION: Over the counter (OTC) Derivative instrument derived data is extra information about Over the counter (OTC) Derivative instrument that can be derived from other information in the model.

NAME: Over the counter (OTC) Derivative instrument
DESCRIPTION: An Over the counter (OTC) Derivative instrument is an Instrument in the form of a derivative that does not have an International securities identification number (ISIN).

NAME: Over the counter (OTC) Derivative instrument Synthetic securitisation assignment
DESCRIPTION: Over the counter (OTC) Derivative instrument Synthetic securitisation assignment is the combination of Over the counter (OTC) Derivative instrument and Synthetic securitisation assignment that indicates which Over the counter (OTC) Derivative instrument is assigned to which Synthetic securitisation assignment.

NAME: Over the counter (OTC) Derivative Seller assignment
DESCRIPTION: An Over the counter (OTC) Derivative Seller assignment is the combination of a Seller and an Over the counter (OTC) Derivative that indicates which Over the counter (OTC) Derivative is sold by which Seller.

NAME: Over the counter (OTC) Forward
DESCRIPTION: An Over the counter (OTC) Forward is an Over the counter (OTC) Derivative instrument through which two Parties agree to buy or sell an asset at a specified price on a future date.

NAME: Over the counter (OTC) Option
DESCRIPTION: An Over the counter (OTC) Option is an Over the counter (OTC) Derivative instrument that offers the Buyer the opportunity to buy or sell the underlying asset.

NAME: Over the counter (OTC) Credit default swap received as collateral instrument
DESCRIPTION: Over the counter (OTC) Credit default swap received as collateral instrument is a Collateral received instrument where the instrument received as collateral is an Over the counter (OTC) Credit default swap.

NAME: Sponsor
DESCRIPTION:
Regulation (EU) 2402/2017, Article 2(5):
‘Sponsor’ means a credit institution, whether located in the Union or not, as defined in point (1) of Article 4(1) of Regulation (EU) No 575/2013, or an investment firm as defined in point (1) of Article 4(1) of Directive 2014/65/EU other than an originator, that: (a) establishes and manages an asset-backed commercial paper programme or other securitisation that purchases exposures from third-party entities, or (b) establishes an asset-backed commercial paper programme or other securitisation that purchases exposures from third-party entities and delegates the day-to-day active portfolio management involved in that securitisation to an entity authorised to perform such activity in accordance with Directive 2009/65/EC, Directive 2011/61/EU or Directive 2014/65/EU.

NAME: Servicer
DESCRIPTION: A Servicer is a Party role where the Party is responsible for the administrative and financial management of a financial operation.

NAME: Securitisation special purpose entity (SSPE)
DESCRIPTION:
Regulation (EU) 2402/2017, Article 2(2):
‘Securitisation special purpose entity’ or ‘SSPE’ means a corporation, trust or other entity, other than an originator or sponsor, established for the purpose of carrying out one or more securitisations, the activities of which are limited to those appropriate to accomplishing that objective, the structure of which is intended to isolate the obligations of the SSPE from those of the originator.

NAME: Renegotiated financial asset instrument without forbearance measure
DESCRIPTION: A Renegotiated financial asset instrument without forbearance measure is a Renegotiated financial asset instrument where no forbearance measure have been applied.

NAME: Renegotiated financial asset instrument with forbearance measure
DESCRIPTION: A Renegotiated financial asset instrument with forbearance measure is a Renegotiated financial asset instrument where forbearance measures have been applied.

NAME: Deferred tax asset
DESCRIPTION: A Deferred tax asset is a Tax asset according to Accounting Directive art 17(1)(f); CRR art 4(1)(106)for IFRS: IAS 1.54(o); IAS 12.5; CRR art 4(1)(106) (for for nGaap).

NAME: Deferred tax liability
DESCRIPTION: According to IAS 1.54(o); IAS 12.5; CRR art 4(1)(108).

NAME: Delta sensitivity
DESCRIPTION: The linear estimate of the change in value of a financial instrument due to a movement in the value of a risk factor. The risk factor could be the price of an equity or commodity, or a change in an interest rate, credit spread or FX rate.

NAME: On demand deposit not used for minimum reserve
DESCRIPTION: On demand deposit not used for minimum reserve is an On demand deposit that is not used to account for the minimum reserve to keep at the central bank, at the savings bank group, or similar.

NAME: Domestic branch
DESCRIPTION: Domestic branch is a Branch that is located in the same country as the Organisation of which it is a legally dependent part.

NAME: Domestic institutional unit
DESCRIPTION:
Domestic institutional unit is an Institutional unit that is the domestic part of a credit institution is one institutional unit which consists of the headquarters and the domestic branch offices.

The headquarters and all branch offices of a credit institution which are located in the same country in which the credit institution is established are jointly referred to as the domestic part of the credit institution.

NAME: Depositor
DESCRIPTION: A Depositor is a Party role where the Party is depositing a certain amount of money at a Deposit-taking corporation.

NAME: Deposit Collateral given assignment
DESCRIPTION: A Deposit Collateral given assignment is the combination of a Deposit and a Collateral given that indicates which Loan is assigned to which Collateral.

NAME: Deposit Depositor assignment
DESCRIPTION: A Deposit Depositor assignment is the combination of a Deposit and a Depositor that indicates which Deposit is assigned to which Depositor.

NAME: Deposit Deposit-taking corporation assignment
DESCRIPTION: A Deposit Deposit-taking corporation assignment is the combination of a Deposit and a Deposit-taking corporation that indicates which Deposit is provided by which Deposit-taking corporation.

NAME: Deposit
DESCRIPTION:
A Deposit is an Instrument fulfilling the definition of Regulation (EU) 549/2013, 5.79 (amended, see remark):

Definition: deposits are standardised, non-negotiable contracts with the public at large and allowing the placement and the later withdrawal of the principal amount by the creditor. Deposits usually involve the debtor giving back the full principal amount to the investor.

Remark: the original definition includes "offered by Deposit-taking corporations and, in some cases, by central government as debtors" which was removed because of the dependency on the involved Party.

NAME: Deposit redeemable at notice
DESCRIPTION:
A Deposits redeemable at notice is an Other deposit fulfilling the definition of Regulation (EU) 1071/2013, Annex 2, Part 2 Definitions of instrument categories, Table Instrument categories, 9.3 Deposits redeemable at notice:
Non-transferable deposits without any agreed maturity which cannot be converted into currency without a period of prior notice; before the expiry the conversion into currency is not possible or possible only with a penalty. They include deposits which, although perhaps legally withdrawable on demand, would be subject to penalties and restrictions according to national practice (classified in the maturity band ‘up to and including three months’), and investment accounts without period of notice or agreed maturity, but which contain restrictive drawing provisions (classified in the maturity band ‘over three months’)

NAME: Repurchase transaction gold (given) assignment
DESCRIPTION: Repurchase transaction gold assignment is the combination of a Repurchase transaction (being a repurchase agreement) and Gold that is given in the repurchase transaction.

NAME: Repurchase transaction Long balance sheet recognised security position (given) assignment
DESCRIPTION: Repurchase transaction Long balance sheet recognised security position assignment is the combination of a Repurchase transaction (being a repurchase agreement) and  Long balance sheet recognised security position that is given in the Repurchase transaction.

NAME: Repurchase transaction Non-balance sheet recognised security position assignment
DESCRIPTION: Repurchase transaction Non-balance sheet recognised security position assignment is the combination of a  Repurchase transaction  and Non-balance sheet recognised security position

NAME: Term repurchase transaction
DESCRIPTION: A Term repurchase agreement instrument is a Repurchase agreement instrument with a specified maturity date.

NAME: Tranche in a synthetic securitisation
DESCRIPTION: Tranche in a synthetic securitisation is a securitisation tranche that is used in a synthetic securitisation.

NAME: Tranche in a synthetic securitisation with Securitisation Special Purpose Entity (SSPE)
DESCRIPTION: Tranche in a synthetic securitisation with SSPE is a Tranche in a synthetic securitisation where there is a Securitisation Special Purpose Entity involved.

NAME: Tranche in a synthetic securitisation without securitisation special purpose entity (SSPE) being a deposit
DESCRIPTION: A Tranche in a synthetic securitisation without securitisation special purpose entity (SSPE) being a Deposit is a Tranche in a synthetic securitisation without securitisation special purpose entity (SSPE) that is a Deposit (acting as a collateral).

NAME: Tranche in a synthetic securitisation without securitisation special purpose entity (SSPE)
DESCRIPTION: A Tranche in a synthetic securitisation without securitisation special purpose entity (SSPE) is either a Financial guarantee or a Deposit acting as a collateral for a particular part of the underlying Pool of assets.

NAME: Tranche in a synthetic securitisation without securitisation special purpose entity (SSPE) being a financial guarantee
DESCRIPTION: A Tranche in a synthetic securitisation without securitisation special purpose entity (SSPE) being a Financial guarantee is a Tranche in a synthetic securitisation without securitisation special purpose entity (SSPE) that is a Financial guarantee.

NAME: Tranche in a Traditional securitisation
DESCRIPTION:
Regulation (EU) 2402/2017, Article 2, (6):
´Tranche’ means a contractually established segment of the credit risk associated with an exposure or a pool of exposures, where a position in the segment entails a risk of credit loss greater than or less than a position of the same amount in another segment, without taking account of credit protection provided by third parties directly to the holders of positions in the segment or in other segments.

NAME: Transferable deposit
DESCRIPTION:
A Transferable deposit is an Overnight deposit fulfilling the definition of Regulation (EU) 549/2013, 5.80:
Definition: transferable deposits are deposits exchangeable for currency on demand, at par, and which are directly usable for making payments by cheque, draft, giro order, direct debit/credit, or other direct payment facilities, without penalty or restriction.

NAME: Transit item
DESCRIPTION:
Regulation (EU) No 1071/2013, Annex 2, Part 2 Definitions of instrument categories, Table Intstrument categories, 7. Remaining assets:
Transit items represent funds, usually belonging to customers, which are in the course of being transmitted between MFIs. Items include cheques and other forms of payment that have been sent for collection to other MFIs;

NAME: Tax asset
DESCRIPTION: Tax asset according to IAS 1.54(n); IAS 12.5, Accounting Directive art 17(1)(f); CRR art 4(1)(106)for IFRS: IAS 1.54(o); CRR art 4(1)(106) (for for nGaap).

NAME: Tax liability
DESCRIPTION: A Tax liability according to IAS 1.54(n);  IAS 12.5; CRR, Article 4(1)(108).

NAME: Registered postal code system party
DESCRIPTION: Registered postal code system party is a Party that uses an address that is in a Registered Postal Code system country.

NAME: Vega sensitivity
DESCRIPTION: The potential loss resulting from the change in value of a derivative due to a change in the implied volatility of its underlying.

NAME: Security borrowing and lending transaction Borrower assignment
DESCRIPTION: A Security borrowing and lending transaction Borrower assignment is an Instrument Entity assignment where the Instrument is a Security borrowing and lending transaction Borrower assignment and the Entity role Borrower.

NAME: Security borrowing and lending transaction component
DESCRIPTION: A Security borrowing and lending transaction component is a Securities borrowing and lending transaction including cash as collateral component that is either a Security borrowed or a Security lent.

NAME: Over the counter (OTC) Total return swap
DESCRIPTION: An Over the counter (OTC) Total return swap is an Over the counter (OTC) Swap in which one Party makes payments based on a set rate (either fixed or variable) while the other party makes payments based on the return of an underlying asset which includes both the income it generates and the capital gains.

NAME: Other advance
DESCRIPTION: An Other advance is an Advance that is neither a Suspense item nor a Transit item.

NAME: Other collateral received instrument
DESCRIPTION: Other collateral received instrument is a Collateral received instrument that is not an Over the counter (OTC) Credit default swap received as collateral instrument.

NAME: Other commodity collateral
DESCRIPTION: Other commodity collateral is a Commodity collateral other than Gold collateral.

NAME: Suspense item
DESCRIPTION:
Regulation (EU) No 1071/2013, Annex 2, Part 2 Definitions of instrument categories, Table Intstrument categories, 7. Remaining assets:
Suspense items are asset balances held in the MFI balance sheet which are not booked in the name of customers but which nevertheless relate to customers’ funds, e.g. funds that are awaiting investment, transfer or settlement;

NAME: State and local government and Social security funds
DESCRIPTION:
Regulation (EU) 549/2013:
State government (excluding social security funds) (S.1312)
2.115 Definition: this subsector consists of those types of public administration which are separate institutional units
exercising some of the functions of government, except for the administration of social security funds, at a level
below that of central government and above that of the governmental institutional units existing at local level.
Included in subsector S.1312 are those non-profit institutions which are controlled by state governments and
whose competence is restricted to the economic territories of the states.
Local government (excluding social security funds) (S.1313)
2.116 Definition: this subsector includes those types of public administration whose competence extends to only a local
part of the economic territory, apart from local agencies of social security funds.
Included in subsector S.1313 are those non-profit institutions which are controlled by local governments and
whose competence is restricted to the economic territories of the local governments.
Social security funds (S.1314)
2.117 Definition: the social security funds subsector includes central, state and local institutional units whose principal
activity is to provide social benefits and which fulfil each of the following two criteria:
(a) by law or by regulation certain groups of the population are obliged to participate in the scheme or to pay
contributions; and
(b) general government is responsible for the management of the institution in respect of the settlement or
approval of the contributions and benefits independently from its role as supervisory body or employer.
There is usually no direct link between the amount of the contribution paid by an individual and the risk to
which that individual is exposed.

NAME: Swap provider
DESCRIPTION: A Swap provider is a Party role where the Party providing a Swap.

NAME: Syndicated contract
DESCRIPTION: Syndicated contract is the overall contract of the syndication in the administration of the lead arranger of the syndicated contract.

NAME: Repurchase transaction Buyer assignment
DESCRIPTION: A Repurchase transaction Seller ssignment  is an Instrument Entity role assignment where the Instrument is a Repurchase transaction and the Entity role is Buyer.

NAME: Repurchase transaction gold (given) assignment
DESCRIPTION: Repurchase transaction gold assignment is the combination of a Repurchase transaction (being a repurchase agreement) and Gold that is given in the repurchase transaction.

NAME: Repurchase transaction
DESCRIPTION: ‘Repurchase transactions (‘repos’) shall be transactions in which the institution receives or loans cash in exchange for financial assets sold/bought  at a given price under a commitment to repurchase the same (or identical) assets at a fixed price on a specified future date. - (FINREP Annex V, part 2.183-184 - Instructions)

NAME: Repurchase transaction Long balance sheet recognised security position (given) assignment
DESCRIPTION: Repurchase transaction Long balance sheet recognised security position assignment is the combination of a Repurchase transaction (being a repurchase agreement) and  Long balance sheet recognised security position that is given in the Repurchase transaction.

NAME: Repurchase transaction Non-balance sheet recognised security position assignment
DESCRIPTION: Repurchase transaction Non-balance sheet recognised security position assignment is the combination of a  Repurchase transaction  and Non-balance sheet recognised security position

NAME: Financial contract
DESCRIPTION: A Financial contract is a legally binding document under which one or multiple Instruments and / or Credit facilities are created.

NAME: Financial corporation
DESCRIPTION:
Regulation (EU) 549/2013, 2.55:
Definition: the financial corporations sector (S.12) consists of institutional units which are independent legal entities and market producers, and whose principal activity is the production of financial services. Such institutional units comprise all corporations and quasi-corporations which are principally engaged in: 
(a) financial intermediation (financial intermediaries); and/or 
(b) auxiliary financial activities (financial auxiliaries). 
Also included are institutional units providing financial services, where most of either their assets or their liabilities are not transacted on open markets.

NAME: Financial guarantee instrument not covering a Debt security
DESCRIPTION: A Financial guarantee instrument not covering a Debt security is a Financial guarantee instrument that does not cover a Debt security.

NAME: Financial guarantee instrument Beneficiary assignment
DESCRIPTION: A Financial guarantee instrument Beneficiary assignment is an Instrument Entity role assignment where the Instrument is a Financial guarantee instrument and the Entity role is Beneficiary.

NAME: Repurchase transaction Non-balance sheet recognised security position (given) assignment
DESCRIPTION: Repurchase transaction Non-balance sheet recognised security position assignment is the combination of a Repurchase transaction  and Non-balance sheet recognised security position that is given in a Repurchase atransaction (after being received in a previous Reverse repurchase transaction).

NAME: Repurchase transaction Seller assignment
DESCRIPTION: A Repurchase transaction Seller assignment  is an Instrument Entity role assignment where the Instrument is a Repurchase transaction and the Entity role is Seller.

NAME: Reporting agent internal group role
DESCRIPTION: A Reporting agent internal group role is an Internal group role where the Internal group acts as a reporting agent.

NAME: Residential Immovable property
DESCRIPTION: Residential Immovable property is a  residential estate property.

NAME: Residential real estate collateral
Risk factor for standardised approach
DESCRIPTION: Risk factor for standardised approach is a set of variables (eg an equity price or a tenor of an interest rate curve) that affect the value of an instrument as defined in MAR21.8 to MAR21.14. (https://www.bis.org/basel_framework/chapter/MAR/21.htm?inforce=20230101&published=20200327#paragraph_MAR_21_20230101_21_8)

NAME: Restructuring
DESCRIPTION: According to IAS 37.71, 84(a).

NAME: Retail exposure class financial asset instrument
DESCRIPTION: A retail exposure class financial asset instrument is a Financial asset instrument fulfilling the definition of Regulation (EU) 575/2013, Article 123 Retail exposure. Please note that this does not imply that such a Financial asset instrument is assigned to the Exposure class Retail exposure but it implies that it could be assigned to it.

NAME: Rating agency
DESCRIPTION:
A (Credit) Rating agency is a credit rating agency that is registered or certified in accordance with Regulation (EC) No 1060/2009 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 16 September 2009 on credit rating agencies or a central bank issuing credit ratings which are exempt from the application of Regulation (EC) No 1060/2009.
A Rating agency can be either an Extern Credit Assessment Institution (ECAI) or an Export Credit Agency (ECA).
An export credit agency (known in trade finance as an ECA) or investment insurance agency is a private or quasi-governmental institution that acts as an intermediary between national governments and exporters to issue export insurance solutions, guarantees for financing. The financing can take the form of credits (financial support) or credit insurance and guarantees (pure cover) or both, depending on the mandate the ECA has been given by its government. ECAs can also offer credit or cover on their own account. This does not differ from normal banking activities. Some agencies are government-sponsored, others private, and others a combination of the two.

NAME: Rating agency excess methodology result Covered bond programme assignment
DESCRIPTION: Rating agency excess methodology result Covered bond assignment is the combination of the Rating agency and the Covered bond that has the result of the credit rating agencies' methodology to maintain current external credit rating of the Covered bond issued with the Covered bond programme for calculating the excess of minimum coverage requirement.

NAME: Non-International securities identification number security
DESCRIPTION: A Non-International securities identification number security is a Security that does not have an International securities identification number (ISIN).

NAME: Non-listed central bank and private sector company
DESCRIPTION: Non-listed central bank and private sector company is a Central bank and private sector company whose shares of ownership are not listed anywhere on a stock exchange.

NAME: Performing non-default financial asset instrument individually assessed
DESCRIPTION: A Performing non-default financial asset instrument individually assessed is a Non-default financial asset instrument individually assessed that is classified as performing according to FINREP, Annex V, part 2 (213)-(239).

NAME: Performing non-retail exposure class financial asset instrument
DESCRIPTION: A Performing non-retail exposure class financial asset instrument is a Non-retail exposure class financial asset instrument that is classified as performing according to FINREP, Annex V, part 2 (213)-(239).

NAME: Property, plant and equipment
DESCRIPTION:
Property, plant and equipment are tangible items that:
(a) are held for use in the production or supply of goods or services, for rental to others, or for administrative purposes; and 
(b) are expected to be used during more than one period. (IAS 16.6)

NAME: Other commitment
DESCRIPTION: An Other commitment is an Off-balance sheet item listed in Annex I of Regulation (EU) 575/2013 (CRR) that is not a Financial guarantee and is not a Credit facility.

NAME: Other deposit
DESCRIPTION:
An Other deposit is a Deposit fulfilling the definition of Regulation (EU) 549/2013, 5.85:
Definition: other deposits are deposits other than transferable deposits. Other deposits cannot be used to make payments except on maturity or after an agreed period of notice, and they are not exchangeable for currency or for transferable deposits without some significant restriction or penalty.

NAME: Other employee benefit
DESCRIPTION: According to IAS 19.153; IAS 1.78(d); Annex V.Part 2.10.

NAME: Rating grade Central bank and private sector company assignment
DESCRIPTION: A Rating grade Other organisation assignment is the combination of a Rating grade for issuer based rating system for non-central government and an Other organisation that indicates which Other organisation is assigned which Rating grade for issuer based rating system for non-central government.

NAME: Rating grade Country assignment
DESCRIPTION: A Rating grade country assignment is the combination of a Rating grade for issuer based rating systems for Central government and a Country that indicates which Rating grade for issuer based rating systems for Central government is assigned to which Country.

NAME: Rating grade for issuer based rating system for central government
DESCRIPTION: A Rating grade for issuer based rating systems for Central government is a Rating grade for issuer based rating systems associated with a Central government.

NAME: Rating grade for issuer based rating system
DESCRIPTION: A Rating grade for issuer based rating systems is a Rating grade associated with an Issuer based rating system.

NAME: Rating grade for issuer based rating system for non-central government
DESCRIPTION: A Rating grade for issuer based rating systems for non-Central government is a Rating grade for issuer based rating systems associated with a Party that is not a Central government.

NAME: Rating grade for issue-based rating system Debt security assignment
DESCRIPTION: A Rating grade for issue based rating system Debt security assignment is the combination of a Rating grade for issue based rating system and a Debt security that indicates which Rating grade for issue based rating system is assigned to which Debt security.

NAME: Rating grade for issue-based rating system
DESCRIPTION: A Rating grade for issue based rating system is a Rating grade associated with an Issue based rating system.

NAME: Rating grade
DESCRIPTION: A Rating grade is a grade representing the probability of default of a Party, Instrument or Debt security.

NAME: Rating system applied to a Legal person
DESCRIPTION: A Rating system applied to a Party is the combination of a Numeric rating system and a Party that indicates which Party is evaluated based on which Numeric rating system with which Probability of Default.

NAME: Rating system
DESCRIPTION: A (Credit) Rating system is a system that evaluates the the creditworthiness of a borrower in general terms or with respect to a particular debt or financial obligation [based on https://www.investopedia.com/terms/c/creditrating.asp].

NAME: (Reverse) repurchase transaction gold collateral received assignment
DESCRIPTION: (Reverse) Repurchase transaction gold collateral received assignment is the combination of a Reverse Repurchase transaction and Gold collateral (received).

NAME: (Reverse) Repurchase transaction Non-balance sheet recognised security position (received) assignment
DESCRIPTION: (Reverse) Repurchase transaction Non-balance sheet recognised security position assignment is the combination of a (reverse) Repurchase transaction  and Non-balance sheet recognised security position that is received in the (reverse) repurchase transaction.

NAME: Non-financial asset
DESCRIPTION: A Non-financial asset is an Asset that is not a Financial asset.

NAME: Non-financial asset and non-financial liability
DESCRIPTION: A Non-financial asset and non-financial liability is a asset or a liability that is not considered a financial asset or liability in the context of the given accounting standard.

NAME: Non-financial corporation
DESCRIPTION:
Regulation (EU) 549/2013, 2.45:
Definition: the non-financial corporations sector (S.11) consists of institutional units which are independent legal entities and market producers, and whose principal activity is the production of goods and non-financial services. The non-financial corporations sector also includes non-financial quasi-corporations (see paragraph 2.13(f)).

NAME: Non-financial liability
DESCRIPTION: A Non-financial liability is a Liability that is not a Financial liability.

NAME: Financial guarantee instrument covering a Debt security Debt security assignment
DESCRIPTION: A Financial guarantee instrument covering a Debt security Debt security assignment is the combination of a Financial guarantee covering a Debt security and a Debt security that indicates which Financial guarantee covering a Debt security is assigned to which Debt security.

NAME: Financial guarantee instrument covering a Debt security
DESCRIPTION: A Financial guarantee instrument covering a Debt security is a Financial guarantee instrument that covers a Debt security.

NAME: Financial guarantee instrument
DESCRIPTION:
A Financial guarantee instrument is an Off-balance instrument that is a Financial guarantee according to Annex V, Part 2, 81(c):
"'Financial guarantees received"  include contracts that require the issuer to make specified payments to reimburse the institution of a loss it incurs, because a specified debtor fails to make payment when due in accordance with the original or modified terms of a debt instrument."

NAME: Financial guarantee instrument Protection provider assignment
DESCRIPTION: A Financial guarantee instrument Protection provider assignment is an Instrument Entity role assignment where the Instrument is a Financial guarantee instrument and the Entity role is Protection provider.

NAME: Financial liability instrument
DESCRIPTION:
A Financial liability instrument is an Instrument role where the Instrument acts in the role of a Financial liability (according to the applied accounting standard) where the instrument is intended as a liability. 

Please note that a Financial liability instrument does not necessarily be recognised in the balance sheet.
Please note too that an instrument can be both an Asset and a Liability at the same time. This can happen, for example, when a debtor overpays the fees and/or installments.

NAME: Financial lease
DESCRIPTION:
A Financial lease is a Loan fulfilling the definition of Annex V, Party 2.85(d):
‘Finance leases’ shall include the carrying amount of finance lease receivables. Under IFRS ‘finance lease receivables’ are as defined in IAS 17;

NAME: Financial lease Lessor assignment
DESCRIPTION: A Financial lease Lessor assignment is the combination of a Financial lease and a Lessor that indicates which Financial lease is assigned to which Lessor.

NAME: Financial lease Lessee assignment
DESCRIPTION: A Financial lease Lessee assignment is the combination of a Financial lease and a Lesee that indicates which Lesee is assigned to which Financial lease.

NAME: Forborne off-balance sheet item given instrument
DESCRIPTION: Forborne off-balance sheet item given instrument is an Off-balance sheet item given instrument that has been declared forborne.

NAME: Equity instrument that is not a security as a hedge
DESCRIPTION: Loan and advance as a hedge is a Loan and advance role where the Loan and advance instrument acts as a non-derivative hedge.

NAME: Equity instrument that is not a security
DESCRIPTION:
An Equity instrument that is not a security is an Instrument that is an Equity instrument (according to Annex V, Part 2.16) that is not an Equity security.

IFRS 2.16:
Under IFRS, equity instruments that are financial instruments shall include those contracts under the scope of IAS 32. 

IAS 32:
An equity instrument is any contract that evidences a residual interest in the assets of an entity after deducting all of its liabilities.

NAME: Exchange tradable derivative liability position Synthetic securitisation assignment
DESCRIPTION: Exchange tradable derivative liability position Synthetic securitisation assignment is the combination of Exchange tradable derivative liability position and Synthetic securitisation assignment that indicates which Exchange tradable derivative liability position is assigned to which Synthetic securitisation assignment.

NAME: Over the counter (OTC) Swap
DESCRIPTION: An Over the counter (OTC) Swap is an Over the counter (OTC) Derivative instrument through which two Parties exchange the cash flows from two different financial instruments.

NAME: Over the counter (OTC) Total return swap
DESCRIPTION: An Over the counter (OTC) Total return swap is an Over the counter (OTC) Swap in which one Party makes payments based on a set rate (either fixed or variable) while the other party makes payments based on the return of an underlying asset which includes both the income it generates and the capital gains.

NAME: Other advance
DESCRIPTION: An Other advance is an Advance that is neither a Suspense item nor a Transit item.

NAME: Other collateral received instrument
DESCRIPTION: Other collateral received instrument is a Collateral received instrument that is not an Over the counter (OTC) Credit default swap received as collateral instrument.

NAME: Other commodity collateral
DESCRIPTION: Other commodity collateral is a Commodity collateral other than Gold collateral.

NAME: Other commitment Creditor assignment
DESCRIPTION: An Other commitment Creditor assignment is an Instrument Entity role where the Instrument is an Other commitment and the Entity role is Creditor.

NAME: Property, plant and equipment taken into possession
DESCRIPTION: Property, plant and equipment taken into possession is Property, plant and equipment that was not pledged by the debtor as collateral, but was obtained in exchange for the cancellation of debt, whether on a voluntary basis or as part of legal proceedings.

NAME: Perpetual debt security
DESCRIPTION: A Perpetual debt security is a Debt security with a fixed income and no maturity date.

NAME: Protection arrangement given Exchange tradable derivative position assignment
DESCRIPTION: Protection arrangement given Exchange tradable derivative position assignment is the combination of Exchange tradable derivative position and Protection arrangement given  stating which Exchange tradable derivative position is offering protection for which Protection arrangement.

NAME: Protection arrangement given Instrument assignment
DESCRIPTION: Protection arrangement given Instrument assignment is the combination of an Instrument and a Protection arrangement given that indicates which Instrument is given to which Product arrangement given.

NAME: Protection arrangement given
DESCRIPTION: A Protection arrangement given is a Protection arrangement role where the Protection arrangement is given.

NAME: Off-balance sheet item given instrument
DESCRIPTION: An Off-balance sheet item given instrument is an Instrument role where the Instrument acts as an Off-balance sheet item given.

NAME: Off-balance sheet item received instrument
DESCRIPTION: An Off-balance sheet item received instrument is an Instrument role where the Instrument acts as an Off-balance sheet item received.

NAME: Open repurchase transaction
DESCRIPTION: An Open repurchase transaction is a Repurchase transaction without a specified maturity date.

NAME: Original lender
DESCRIPTION:
Regulation (EU) 2402/2017, Article 2(20):
‘Original lender’ means an entity which, itself or through related entities, directly or indirectly, concluded the original agreement which created the obligations or potential obligations of the debtor or potential debtor giving rise to the exposures being securitised.

NAME: Organisational unit
DESCRIPTION:
A Organisational unit is a Party that is not (directly) documented by a legal document like a birth certificate for Natural persons, an article of association for limited (liability) companies.
Organisational units are individual building blocks that makes up an organisation. An Organisational unit constitutes one of the several functions within a company.
Contrary to a Legal person, Organisational units cannot, or only to a limited extend acquire legal rights and obligrations.

NAME: Organisation
DESCRIPTION: An Organisation is a Legal person which is an organized group of people with a particular purpose.

NAME: Organisation role
DESCRIPTION: An Organisation role is an Organisation acting in a specific role. For example an Organisation acting in the role of a Securitisation special purpose entity (SSPE).

NAME: Organisation risk data
DESCRIPTION: An Organisation risk data is additional risk related information about an Organisation.

NAME: Organisation without legal proceeding
DESCRIPTION: An Organisation without legal proceeding is an Organisation without a Legal proceedings status.

NAME: Organisation with legal proceeding
DESCRIPTION: An Organisation with legal proceeding is an Organisation with a Legal proceedings status.

NAME: Originator
DESCRIPTION:
Regulation (EU) 2402/2017, Article 2(3):
‘Originator’ means an entity which: (a) itself or through related entities, directly or indirectly, was involved in the original agreement which created the obligations or potential obligations of the debtor or potential debtor giving rise to the exposures being securitised; or (b) purchases a third party’s exposures on its own account and then securitises them.

NAME: Over the counter (OTC) Credit default swap
DESCRIPTION: An Over the counter (OTC) Credit default swap (CDS) is an Over the counter (OTC) Swap where the Seller of the CDS will compensate the Buyer in a specified (default) event.

NAME: Long balance sheet recognised security position prudential portfolio Accounting classification assignment International Financial Reporting Standard (IFRS)
DESCRIPTION: Long balance sheet recognised security position  prudential portfolio Accounting classification assignment International Financial Reporting Standard (IFRS)  is a Long balance sheet recognised security position  prudential portfolio Accounting classification assignment reported under IFRS.

NAME: Long balance sheet recognised security position prudential portfolio Accounting classification assignment
DESCRIPTION: A Long balance sheet recognised security position prudential portfolio Accounting classification assignment is the combination between Long balance sheet recognised security position prudential portfolio assignment and Accounting classifcation.

NAME: Non-forborne off-balance sheet item given instrument
DESCRIPTION: Non-forborne off-balance sheet item given instrument is an Off-balance sheet item given instrument that has not been declared forborne.

NAME: Non-fair-valued balance sheet recognised financial liability instrument
DESCRIPTION: A Non-fair-valued balance sheet recognised financial liability instrument is a Balance sheet recognised financial liability instrument that is not fair valued.

NAME: Non-fair-valued balance sheet recognised exchange tradable derivative asset position
DESCRIPTION: A Non-fair-valued balance sheet recognised exchange tradable derivative asset position is a Balance sheet recognised exchange tradable derivative position role which is not Fair valued.

NAME: Non-fair-valued balance sheet recognised financial asset instrument
DESCRIPTION: A Non-fair valued balance sheet recognised financial asset instrument is a Balance sheet recognised financial asset instrument that is not fair valued.

NAME: Non-fair-valued debt security issued
DESCRIPTION: A Non-fair-valued debt security issued is a Debt security issued that is not fair valued.

NAME: Non-fixed interest financial asset instrument
DESCRIPTION: A Non-fixed interest financial asset instrument is a Financial asset instrument with non-fixed interest rate.

NAME: Non-interest-only financial asset instrument
DESCRIPTION: A Non-interest-only financial asset instrument is a Financial asset instrument without an interest-only period.

NAME: Non-International securities identification number exchange tradable derivative
DESCRIPTION: An Non-International securities identification number exchange tradable derivative is an Exchange tradable derivative without an International securities identification number (ISIN).

NAME: Foreign exchange risk factor for standardised approach
DESCRIPTION: The Foreign exchange risk factor for SA is a risk factor based on the currency in which an instrument is denominated and the institution's reporting currency. (Article 325q) - Regulation (EU) No 575/2013 of the European Parliament and of the Council (CRR)

NAME: Internal group Key management personnel assignment
DESCRIPTION: Internal group Key management personnel assignment is the combination of Internal Group and Key management personnel that indicates which Key management personnel are part of the Internal group.

NAME: Internal group
DESCRIPTION: An Internal group is a Group that comprises Parties that are related to the Reporting agent.

NAME: Internal group role
DESCRIPTION: A Internal group role is a role an Internal group may act in.

NAME: International organisation and general government
DESCRIPTION: An International organisation and general government is an Organisation that is either an International organisation or a General government.

NAME: International organisation
DESCRIPTION:
An International organisation is an International organisation and General government drawing membership from more than one state, having activities in several states, and whose members are held together by a formal agreement.
Please note that this entity comprises multilateral development banks.

NAME: Interest-only financial asset instrument
DESCRIPTION: A Interest-only financial asset instrument is a Financial asset instrument with an interest-only period.

NAME: Interest rate risk hedge portfolio
DESCRIPTION:
Interest rate risk hedge portfolio are the portfolio of instruments whose hedged postions need to be reported as one with the rows called 'Fair value changes of the hedged items in portfolio hedge of interest rate risk'.

See https://www.ifrs.org/content/dam/ifrs/meetings/2010/september/iasb/vbfi0910b14bobs.pdf

NAME: Inventory collateral
DESCRIPTION: Inventory collateral is Non-registered collateral in the form of inventory.

NAME: Security borrowing and lending transaction
DESCRIPTION: A Security borrowing and lending transaction is a Securities financing transaction (SFT) where one or more Securities are exchanged (i.e. borrowed or lent) from one of the involved Parties to the other.

NAME: Security borrowing and lending transaction including cash as collateral component
DESCRIPTION: A Securities borrowing and lending transaction including cash as collateral component is a component of a Securities borrowing and lending transaction, i.e. a Security borrowed, a Security lent or cash as collateral.

NAME: Security borrowing and lending transaction Lender assignment
DESCRIPTION: A Security borrowing and lending transaction Lender assignment is an Instrument Entity role assignment where the Instrument is a Security borrowing and lending transaction and the Entity role is Lender.

NAME: Other commitment
DESCRIPTION: An Other commitment is an Off-balance sheet item listed in Annex I of Regulation (EU) 575/2013 (CRR) that is not a Financial guarantee and is not a Credit facility.

NAME: Other deposit
DESCRIPTION:
An Other deposit is a Deposit fulfilling the definition of Regulation (EU) 549/2013, 5.85:
Definition: other deposits are deposits other than transferable deposits. Other deposits cannot be used to make payments except on maturity or after an agreed period of notice, and they are not exchangeable for currency or for transferable deposits without some significant restriction or penalty.

NAME: Rating grade Country assignment
DESCRIPTION: A Rating grade country assignment is the combination of a Rating grade for issuer based rating systems for Central government and a Country that indicates which Rating grade for issuer based rating systems for Central government is assigned to which Country.

NAME: Rating grade
DESCRIPTION: A Rating grade is a grade representing the probability of default of a Party, Instrument or Debt security.

NAME: Rating grade for issuer based rating system for central government
DESCRIPTION: A Rating grade for issuer based rating systems for Central government is a Rating grade for issuer based rating systems associated with a Central government.

NAME: Rating grade for issuer based rating system
DESCRIPTION: A Rating grade for issuer based rating systems is a Rating grade associated with an Issuer based rating system.

NAME: Rating grade for issuer based rating system for non-central government
DESCRIPTION: A Rating grade for issuer based rating systems for non-Central government is a Rating grade for issuer based rating systems associated with a Party that is not a Central government.

NAME: Rating grade for issue-based rating system Debt security assignment
DESCRIPTION: A Rating grade for issue based rating system Debt security assignment is the combination of a Rating grade for issue based rating system and a Debt security that indicates which Rating grade for issue based rating system is assigned to which Debt security.

NAME: Rating grade for issue-based rating system
DESCRIPTION: A Rating grade for issue based rating system is a Rating grade associated with an Issue based rating system.

NAME: Rating system applied to a Legal person
DESCRIPTION: A Rating system applied to a Party is the combination of a Numeric rating system and a Party that indicates which Party is evaluated based on which Numeric rating system with which Probability of Default.

NAME: Rating system
DESCRIPTION: A (Credit) Rating system is a system that evaluates the the creditworthiness of a borrower in general terms or with respect to a particular debt or financial obligation [based on https://www.investopedia.com/terms/c/creditrating.asp].

NAME: (Reverse) repurchase transaction gold collateral received assignment
DESCRIPTION: (Reverse) Repurchase transaction gold collateral received assignment is the combination of a Reverse Repurchase transaction and Gold collateral (received).

NAME: (Reverse) Repurchase transaction Non-balance sheet recognised security position (received) assignment derived data
DESCRIPTION: (Reverse) Repurchase transaction Non-balance sheet recognised security position assignment derived data  is additional data of (Reverse) Repurchase transaction Non-balance sheet recognised security position (received) assignment

NAME: Repurchase transaction Non-balance sheet recognised security position (given) assignment
DESCRIPTION: Repurchase transaction Non-balance sheet recognised security position assignment is the combination of a Repurchase transaction  and Non-balance sheet recognised security position that is given in a Repurchase atransaction (after being received in a previous Reverse repurchase transaction).

NAME: Repurchase transaction Seller assignment
DESCRIPTION: A Repurchase transaction Seller assignment  is an Instrument Entity role assignment where the Instrument is a Repurchase transaction and the Entity role is Seller.

NAME: Reporting agent internal group role
DESCRIPTION: A Reporting agent internal group role is an Internal group role where the Internal group acts as a reporting agent.

NAME: Residential Immovable property
DESCRIPTION: Residential Immovable property is a  residential estate property.

NAME: Residential real estate collateral
Key management personnel
DESCRIPTION: Key management personnel is a Natural person group role for those persons having authority and responsibility for planning, directing, and controlling the activities of the legal entity, directly or indirectly, including any directors (whether executive or otherwise) of the legal entity. [IAS 24.9]

NAME: Goodwill
DESCRIPTION:
https://www.investopedia.com/terms/g/goodwill.asp:
Goodwill is an intangible asset that is associated with the purchase of one company by another. Specifically, goodwill is recorded in a situation in which the purchase price is higher than the sum of the fair value of all identifiable tangible and intangible assets purchased in the acquisition and the liabilities assumed in the process. The value of a company’s brand name, solid customer base, good customer relations, good employee relations, and any patents or proprietary technology represent some examples of goodwill.

NAME: General interest rate risk (GIRR) factor for standardised approach
DESCRIPTION: The General Interest Rate Risk (GIRR) factor refers to the sensitivity of financial instruments to changes in risk-free interest rates across different maturities and currencies. These include risks from inflation and cross-currency basis spreads. (Article 325l) - Regulation (EU) No 575/2013 of the European Parliament and of the Council (CRR)

NAME: Gold collateral
DESCRIPTION:
Gold collateral is a Commodity collateral in the form of gold. 

According to ESA 2010, this is classified as "Non-monetary gold". See ESA 2010 paragraph 5.65 - 5.68.

NAME: Gold
DESCRIPTION: Gold is a non-financial asset including gold bullion and unallocated gold accounts but excluding gold as currency.

NAME: General government
DESCRIPTION:
Regulation (EU) 549/2013, 2.111:
Definition: the general government sector (S.13) consists of institutional units which are non-market producers whose output is intended for individual and collective consumption, and are financed by compulsory payments made by units belonging to other sectors, and institutional units principally engaged in the redistribution of national income and wealth.

NAME: Graded rating system
DESCRIPTION: A Graded Rating system is a Rating system that assigns a Rating grade to a Party, Instrument or Debt security.

NAME: Guarantor Debt security assignment
DESCRIPTION:
A Guarantor Debt security assignment assignment is the combination of Guarantor and Debt security that indicates which Guarantor is providing the guarantee for which Debt security.

The guarantor is obliged to make payments to the holder of the security if the issuer fails to meet the obligation to make repayments arising under the instrument secured by the guarantor. Providers of a "financial guarantee", as defined in Annex V to Regulation (EU) No 680/2014, should be covered.
Protection may be provided by several guarantors, in which case only one of the guarantors is to be reported based on reasonable and risk-prudent considerations (e.g., subordination of liabilities, extent of the contribution to the joint protection).
If the attribute is not applicable to the security due to the unavailability of guarantees,the relevant NCB may dispense with the requirement to fill the attribute. (Guidance notes to reporting agents on SHS regulation)

NAME: Guarantor
DESCRIPTION: A Guarantor is a Party role where the Party is obliged to make payments to the holder of the security if the issuer fails to meet the obligation to make repayments arising under the instrument secured by the guarantor. Providers of a “financial guarantee”, as defined in Annex V to Regulation (EU) No 680/2014, should be covered.

NAME: Group of clients Key management personnel assignment
DESCRIPTION: Group of clients Key management personnel assignment is the combination of Group of clients and Key management personnel indicating, which Key management personnel is part of which Group of clients.

NAME: Group of clients
DESCRIPTION: A Group of clients is a Group that is not an Internal group.

NAME: Group of connected clients
DESCRIPTION: A Group of connected clients is a Group of clients that comprises Parties that are economically dependent on each other.

NAME: Group of consolidated clients
DESCRIPTION: A Group of consolidated clients is a Group of clients that combines account and balance data from multiple subsidiary client records into one master client record.

NAME: Group Key management personnel assignment
DESCRIPTION: Group - Key management personnel assignment is the generalisation of the relationship types between any Group and any Key management personnel.

NAME: Non-performing debt security
DESCRIPTION: Non-performing debt security is a debt security that is classified as non-performing.

NAME: Non-performing financial asset instrument debtor assessed
DESCRIPTION: A Non-performing financial asset instrument debtor assessed is a Financial asset instrument debtor assessed that is classified as non-performing according to FINREP, Annex V, part 2 (213)-(239).

NAME: Non-performing non-default financial asset instrument individually assessed
DESCRIPTION: A Non-performing non-default financial asset instrument individually assessed is a Non-default financial asset instrument individually assessed that is classified as non-performing according to FINREP, Annex V, part 2 (213)-(239).

NAME: Security collateral
DESCRIPTION: Security collateral is Financial collateral in the form of a Security.

NAME: Security lending component Security assignment
DESCRIPTION: Security lending component Security assignment is the combination of the Security lending component and the Security that indicates which Security has been lent out via the Security lending component.

NAME: Short balance sheet recognised security position
DESCRIPTION: A Short security position balance sheet is a Security position where the Investor (i.e. the holder of the Security position) sells the Security first with the intention to repurchasing it or covering it later (at a lower price).

NAME: Short balance sheet recognised security position International Financial Reporting Standard (IFRS)
DESCRIPTION: Short balance sheet recognised security position International Financial Reporting Standard (IFRS) is a Short  balance sheet recognised security position reported under IFRS.

NAME: Short balance sheet recognised security position national general accepted accounting principles (nGAAP)
DESCRIPTION: Short balance sheet recognised security position national general accepted accounting principles (nGAAP) is a Short  balance sheet recognised security position reported under nGAAP.

NAME: Short balance sheet recognised security position national general accepted accounting principles (nGAAP) fiduciary item
DESCRIPTION: A Short balance sheet recognised security position national general accepted accounting principles (nGAAP) fiduciary instrument is  Short balance sheet recognised security position national general accepted accounting principles (nGAAP) that is a fiduciary item.

NAME: Short balance sheet recognised security position prudential portfolio assignment
DESCRIPTION: A Long  balance sheet recognised security position prudential portfolio assignment is the combination of a Long balance sheet recognised security position prudential portfolio assignment and a Prudential portfolio that indicates which security position is assigned to which Prudential portfolio.

NAME: Share capital repayable on demand
DESCRIPTION: According to IAS 32 IE 33; IFRIC 2; Annex V.Part 2.12.

NAME: Self-employed natural person
DESCRIPTION: A Self employed natural person is a Natural person that is self employed.

NAME: Seller
DESCRIPTION: A Seller is a Party role where the Party sells goods (to a Buyer).

NAME: Syndication or sub-participation member instrument Payment agent assignment
DESCRIPTION: Syndication or sub-participation member instrument Agent bank assignment is an Instrument Entity role assignment that indicates if an instrument is part of a syndication loan or part of a sub-participation, which Agent bank is acting as the payment agent in that syndicate or sub-participation.

NAME: Syndication or sub-participation member instrument
DESCRIPTION: Syndication or sub-participation member instrument is a Loan (exluding repurchase agreement) that is part of either a syndicated loan or a sub-participation.

NAME: Single financial contract
DESCRIPTION: Single financial contract is a Financial contract that is not part of a Syndicated contract.

NAME: Sponsor
DESCRIPTION:
Regulation (EU) 2402/2017, Article 2(5):
‘Sponsor’ means a credit institution, whether located in the Union or not, as defined in point (1) of Article 4(1) of Regulation (EU) No 575/2013, or an investment firm as defined in point (1) of Article 4(1) of Directive 2014/65/EU other than an originator, that: (a) establishes and manages an asset-backed commercial paper programme or other securitisation that purchases exposures from third-party entities, or (b) establishes an asset-backed commercial paper programme or other securitisation that purchases exposures from third-party entities and delegates the day-to-day active portfolio management involved in that securitisation to an entity authorised to perform such activity in accordance with Directive 2009/65/EC, Directive 2011/61/EU or Directive 2014/65/EU.

NAME: Subsidiary, joint venture and associate Associate assignment
DESCRIPTION: A Subsidiary, joint venture and associate Associate assignment is a Subsidiary, joint venture and associate Other organisation role assignment where the Other organisation role is Associate.

NAME: Subsidiary, joint venture and associate Joint venture assignment
DESCRIPTION: A Subsidiary, joint venture and associate Joint venture assignment is a Subsidiary, joint venture and associate Other organisation role assignment where the Other organisation role is Joint venture.

NAME: Risk factor for standardised approach
DESCRIPTION: Risk factor for standardised approach is a set of variables (eg an equity price or a tenor of an interest rate curve) that affect the value of an instrument as defined in MAR21.8 to MAR21.14. (https://www.bis.org/basel_framework/chapter/MAR/21.htm?inforce=20230101&published=20200327#paragraph_MAR_21_20230101_21_8)

NAME: Restructuring
DESCRIPTION: According to IAS 37.71, 84(a).

NAME: Retail exposure class financial asset instrument
DESCRIPTION: A retail exposure class financial asset instrument is a Financial asset instrument fulfilling the definition of Regulation (EU) 575/2013, Article 123 Retail exposure. Please note that this does not imply that such a Financial asset instrument is assigned to the Exposure class Retail exposure but it implies that it could be assigned to it.

NAME: Rating agency excess methodology result Covered bond programme assignment
DESCRIPTION: Rating agency excess methodology result Covered bond assignment is the combination of the Rating agency and the Covered bond that has the result of the credit rating agencies' methodology to maintain current external credit rating of the Covered bond issued with the Covered bond programme for calculating the excess of minimum coverage requirement.

NAME: Rating agency
DESCRIPTION:
A (Credit) Rating agency is a credit rating agency that is registered or certified in accordance with Regulation (EC) No 1060/2009 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 16 September 2009 on credit rating agencies or a central bank issuing credit ratings which are exempt from the application of Regulation (EC) No 1060/2009.
A Rating agency can be either an Extern Credit Assessment Institution (ECAI) or an Export Credit Agency (ECA).
An export credit agency (known in trade finance as an ECA) or investment insurance agency is a private or quasi-governmental institution that acts as an intermediary between national governments and exporters to issue export insurance solutions, guarantees for financing. The financing can take the form of credits (financial support) or credit insurance and guarantees (pure cover) or both, depending on the mandate the ECA has been given by its government. ECAs can also offer credit or cover on their own account. This does not differ from normal banking activities. Some agencies are government-sponsored, others private, and others a combination of the two.

NAME: Non-International securities identification number security
DESCRIPTION: A Non-International securities identification number security is a Security that does not have an International securities identification number (ISIN).

NAME: Non-listed central bank and private sector company
DESCRIPTION: Non-listed central bank and private sector company is a Central bank and private sector company whose shares of ownership are not listed anywhere on a stock exchange.

NAME: Non-performing debt security
DESCRIPTION: Non-performing debt security is a debt security that is classified as non-performing.

NAME: Non-performing financial asset instrument debtor assessed
DESCRIPTION: A Non-performing financial asset instrument debtor assessed is a Financial asset instrument debtor assessed that is classified as non-performing according to FINREP, Annex V, part 2 (213)-(239).

NAME: Non-performing non-default financial asset instrument individually assessed
DESCRIPTION: A Non-performing non-default financial asset instrument individually assessed is a Non-default financial asset instrument individually assessed that is classified as non-performing according to FINREP, Annex V, part 2 (213)-(239).

NAME: European Union member party
DESCRIPTION: European Union member party is a Registered postal code system party that uses an address that is a European Union member address.

NAME: Exchange tradable derivative asset or liability position
DESCRIPTION: Exchane tradable derivative asset or liability position is an Exchange tradable derivative poristoin role where the Exchange tradable derivative position acts either in the role of an asset or in the role of a liability.

NAME: Exchange tradable derivative asset position
DESCRIPTION: An Exchange tradable derivative asset position is an Exchange tradable derivative asset or liability position role where the Exchange tradable derivative position acts in the role of an asset position.

NAME: Exchange tradable derivative collateral
DESCRIPTION: Exchange tradable derivative collateral is a Financial collateral that is in the form of an Exchange tradable derivative.

NAME: Exchange tradable derivative position as a hedge
DESCRIPTION: Exchange tradable derivative position as a hedge is an Exchange tradable derivative position role that is applicable to those exchange tradable derivatives that is used in its role as a qualifying hedge.

NAME: Exchange tradable derivative position Protection arrangement received assignment
DESCRIPTION: Exchange tradable derivative position Protection arrangement received assignment is the combination of Exchange tradable derivative position and Protection arrangement received stating which Exchange tradable derivative position is protected by which Protection arrangement.

NAME: Non-performing non-retail exposure class financial asset instrument
DESCRIPTION: A Non-performing non-retail exposure class financial asset instrument is a Non-retail exposure class financial asset instrument that is classified as non-performing according to FINREP, Annex V, part 2 (213)-(239).

NAME: Non-perpetual debt security
DESCRIPTION:
