NAME: Synthetic securitisation
DESCRIPTION: Regulation (EU) 2402/2017, Article 2(10): ‘Synthetic securitisation’ means a securitisation where the transfer of risk is achieved by the use of credit derivatives or guarantees, and the exposures being securitised remain exposures of the originator.

NAME: Tranche in a synthetic securitisation with Securitisation Special Purpose Entity (SSPE)
DESCRIPTION: Tranche in a synthetic securitisation with SSPE is a Tranche in a synthetic securitisation where there is a Securitisation Special Purpose Entity involved.

NAME: Tranche in a synthetic securitisation without securitisation special purpose entity (SSPE) being a deposit

NAME: Security borrowing and lending transaction including cash as collateral component
DESCRIPTION: A Securities borrowing and lending transaction including cash as collateral component is a component of a Securities borrowing and lending transaction, i.e. a Security borrowed, a Security lent or cash as collateral.

NAME: Deposit with agreed maturity
DESCRIPTION:
A Deposit with agreed maturity is an Other deposit fulfilling the definition of Regulation (EU) 1071/2013, annex 2, Part 2 Definitions of instrument categories, Table Instrument categories, 9.2. Deposits with agreed maturity:
Non-transferable deposits which cannot be converted into currency before an agreed fixed term or that can only be converted into currency before that agreed term provided that the holder is charged some kind of penalty. This item also includes administratively regulated savings deposits where the maturity related criterion is not relevant; these should be classified in the maturity band ‘over two years’. Financial products with roll-over provisions must be classified according to the earliest maturity. Although deposits with agreed maturity may feature the possibility of earlier redemption after prior notification, or may be redeemable on demand subject to certain penalties, these features are not considered to be relevant for classification purposes.

NAME: European Central Bank
DESCRIPTION: European Central Bank is a Central Bank that is the central bank of the European Union countries which have adopted the Euro as their currency. The ECB is an official EU institution at the heart of the Eurosystem and the Single Supervisory Mechanism.

NAME: Asset backed security
DESCRIPTION:
An Asset backed security (ABS) is a Debt security with underlying assets where, in the event of failure (of payment) of the issuer, the underlying assets are not used on a priority basis for the reimbursement of the Asset backed security (ABS).
An asset-backed security (ABS) is a type of financial investment that is collateralized by an underlying pool of assets—usually ones that generate a cash flow from debt, such as loans, leases, credit card balances, or receivables. It takes the form of a bond or note, paying income at a fixed rate for a set amount of time, until maturity. For income-oriented investors, asset-backed securities can be an alternative to other debt instruments, like corporate bonds or bond funds.

NAME: Accounting consolidation group
DESCRIPTION: An Accounting consolidation group is an Internal consolidation group according to IFRS.

NAME: Advance Creditor assignment
DESCRIPTION: An Advance Creditor assignment is an Instrument Entity role assignment where the Instrument is an Advance and the Entity role is Creditor.

NAME: Advance Loan debtor assignment
DESCRIPTION: An Advance Loan debtor assignment is an Instrument Entity role assignment where the Instrument is an Advance and the Entity role is Loan debtor.

NAME: Advance
DESCRIPTION:
An Advance is a Loan and Advance that is an Advance according to Annex V, Part 2.85(g):
‘Advances that are not loans’ shall include advances that cannot be classified as ‘loans’ according to the ECB BSI Regulation. This item shall include, among others, gross amounts receivable in respect of suspense items (such as funds that are awaiting investment, transfer, or settlement) and transit items (such as cheques and other forms of payment that have been sent for collection).

NAME: Aircraft collateral
DESCRIPTION: Aircraft collateral is Registered collateral in the form of an Aircraft (or parts of an Aircraft).

NAME: Associate (of the reporting agent)
DESCRIPTION: An Associate is an Other organisation role where the Reporting agent (as an Investor) has significant influence over the Other organisation (see International Accounting Standard (IAS) 28: Investments in Associates and Joint Ventures (3)).

NAME: Assigned debtor derived data
DESCRIPTION: Assigned debtor derived data is additional information about a Assigned debtor.

NAME: Assigned debtor
DESCRIPTION: An Assigned debtor is a Legal person role where the Legal person is either the Customer or the Ultimate debtor of a Factoring operation, depending on the type of Factoring operation, specifically with or without resourse).

NAME: Asset pool Collateral received assignment
DESCRIPTION: An Asset pool Debt security position assignment is the combination of an Asset pool and a Debt security position that indicates which (part of a) Debt security position is comprised in which Asset pool.

NAME: Asset pool (subject to a credit transfer other than securitisation and covered bond programme)
DESCRIPTION: An Asset pool (subject to other credit transfer different than a Covered bond programme) is an Asset pool (subject to a Securitisation and other credit transfer) that is associated with an other credit transfer different than Covered bond programme.

NAME: Asset pool (subject to a Covered bond programme)
DESCRIPTION: An Asset pool (subject to a Covered bond programme) is an Asset pool (subject to a Securitisation and other credit transfer) that is associated with a Covered bond programme.

NAME: Asset pool Deposit assignment derived data
DESCRIPTION: Asset pool Deposit assignment derived data is additional information about Asset pool Deposit assignment.

NAME: Asset pool Deposit assignment
DESCRIPTION: An Asset pool Deposit assignment is the combination of an Asset pool (subject to a securitisation and other credit transfer) and a Deposit that indicates which Deposit  is assigned to which Asset pool (subject to a securitisation and other credit transfer).

NAME: Financial liability instrument
DESCRIPTION:
A Financial liability instrument is an Instrument role where the Instrument acts in the role of a Financial liability (according to the applied accounting standard) where the instrument is intended as a liability. 

Please note that a Financial liability instrument does not necessarily be recognised in the balance sheet.
Please note too that an instrument can be both an Asset and a Liability at the same time. This can happen, for example, when a debtor overpays the fees and/or installments.

NAME: Financial lease
DESCRIPTION:
A Financial lease is a Loan fulfilling the definition of Annex V, Party 2.85(d):
‘Finance leases’ shall include the carrying amount of finance lease receivables. Under IFRS ‘finance lease receivables’ are as defined in IAS 17;

NAME: Financial lease Lessor assignment
DESCRIPTION: A Financial lease Lessor assignment is the combination of a Financial lease and a Lessor that indicates which Financial lease is assigned to which Lessor.

NAME: Financial lease Lessee assignment
DESCRIPTION: A Financial lease Lessee assignment is the combination of a Financial lease and a Lesee that indicates which Lesee is assigned to which Financial lease.

NAME: Forborne off-balance sheet item given instrument
DESCRIPTION: Forborne off-balance sheet item given instrument is an Off-balance sheet item given instrument that has been declared forborne.

NAME: Financial guarantee instrument covering a Debt security
DESCRIPTION: A Financial guarantee instrument covering a Debt security is a Financial guarantee instrument that covers a Debt security.

NAME: Foreign branch derived data
DESCRIPTION: Foreign branch derived data is additional information about a foreign branch

NAME: Foreign branch
DESCRIPTION: Foreign branch is a Branch that is located in another country then the Organisation of which it is a legally dependent part.

NAME: Long non-balance sheet recognised security position protection arrangement received assignment
DESCRIPTION: Long non-balance sheet recognised security position Protection arrangement received assignment is the combination of Long non-balance sheet recognised security position Protection arrangement received and Protection arrangement received stating which Long non-balance sheet recognised security position is protected by which Protection arrangement.

NAME: Long/Short balance sheet recognised security position
DESCRIPTION: A Long/Short balance sheet recognised security position is a balance sheet recognised security position that is either long or short.

NAME: Long/Short balance sheet recognised security position as a hedge
DESCRIPTION: Long/Short balance sheet recognised security position as a hedge is the role in which the Security position role acts as a hedge.

NAME: Linked enterprise assignment
DESCRIPTION: A Linked enterprise is a combination of a Central bank and private sector company and a Central bank and private sector company that indicates which Central bank and private sector company is linked to which Central bank and private sector company in the sense of Commission Recommendation 2003/361/EC.

NAME: Linked enterprise
DESCRIPTION: Linked enterprises are enterprises which have any of the relationships defined in Commission Recommendation 2003/361/EC, Article 3 (3). (Commission Recommendation 2003/361/EC)

NAME: Loan and advance derived data
DESCRIPTION: Loan and advance derived data is additional information about Loan and advance.

NAME: Loan and advance Collateral received assignment derived data
DESCRIPTION: Loan and advance Collateral received assignment derived data is additional information about Loan and advance Collateral received assignment.

NAME: Loan and advance Collateral received assignment
DESCRIPTION: A Loan Collateral received assignment is the combination of a Loan and a Collateral received that indicates which Loan is assigned to which Collateral.

NAME: Loan and advance
DESCRIPTION: A Loan and Advance is an Instrument that is either a Loan acording to Regulation (EU) 1071/2013 or an Advance according to Annex V, Part 2.85(g).

NAME: Loan and advance as a hedge
DESCRIPTION: Loan and advance as a hedge is a Loan and advance role where the Loan  and advance instrument acts as a non-derivative hedge.

NAME: Loan debtor derived data
DESCRIPTION: Loan debtor derived data is additional information about a Loan debtor.

NAME: Loan debtor
DESCRIPTION: A Loan debtor is a Party role where the Party has the unconditional obligation to make repayments arising from a financial operation that is a Loan.

NAME: Loan derived data
DESCRIPTION: Loan derived data is additional information about Loan.

NAME: Loan
DESCRIPTION: A Loan is a Loan and Advance that is a Loan according to Regulation (EU) 1071/2013.

NAME: Non-forborne off-balance sheet item given instrument
DESCRIPTION: Non-forborne off-balance sheet item given instrument is an Off-balance sheet item given instrument that has not been declared forborne.

NAME: Non-fair-valued balance sheet recognised financial liability instrument
DESCRIPTION: A Non-fair-valued balance sheet recognised financial liability instrument is a Balance sheet recognised financial liability instrument that is not fair valued.

NAME: Non-fair-valued balance sheet recognised exchange tradable derivative asset position
DESCRIPTION: A Non-fair-valued balance sheet recognised exchange tradable derivative asset position is a Balance sheet recognised exchange tradable derivative position role which is not Fair valued.

NAME: Non-fair-valued balance sheet recognised financial asset instrument
DESCRIPTION: A Non-fair valued balance sheet recognised financial asset instrument is a Balance sheet recognised financial asset instrument that is not fair valued.

NAME: Non-fair-valued debt security issued
DESCRIPTION: A Non-fair-valued debt security issued is a Debt security issued that is not fair valued.

NAME: Non-fixed interest financial asset instrument
DESCRIPTION: A Non-fixed interest financial asset instrument is a Financial asset instrument with non-fixed interest rate.

NAME: Non-interest-only financial asset instrument
DESCRIPTION: A Non-interest-only financial asset instrument is a Financial asset instrument without an interest-only period.

NAME: Non-International securities identification number exchange tradable derivative
DESCRIPTION: An Non-International securities identification number exchange tradable derivative is an Exchange tradable derivative without an International securities identification number (ISIN).

NAME: Non-International securities identification number security derived data
DESCRIPTION: Non-International securities identification number security derived data is derived information about a Non-International securities identification number (non-ISIN) security.

NAME: Goodwill
DESCRIPTION:
https://www.investopedia.com/terms/g/goodwill.asp:
Goodwill is an intangible asset that is associated with the purchase of one company by another. Specifically, goodwill is recorded in a situation in which the purchase price is higher than the sum of the fair value of all identifiable tangible and intangible assets purchased in the acquisition and the liabilities assumed in the process. The value of a company’s brand name, solid customer base, good customer relations, good employee relations, and any patents or proprietary technology represent some examples of goodwill.

NAME: General interest rate risk (GIRR) factor for standardised approach
DESCRIPTION: The General Interest Rate Risk (GIRR) factor refers to the sensitivity of financial instruments to changes in risk-free interest rates across different maturities and currencies. These include risks from inflation and cross-currency basis spreads. (Article 325l) - Regulation (EU) No 575/2013 of the European Parliament and of the Council (CRR)

NAME: Gold collateral
DESCRIPTION:
Gold collateral is a Commodity collateral in the form of gold. 

According to ESA 2010, this is classified as "Non-monetary gold". See ESA 2010 paragraph 5.65 - 5.68.

NAME: Gold
DESCRIPTION: Gold is a non-financial asset including gold bullion and unallocated gold accounts but excluding gold as currency.

NAME: General government
DESCRIPTION:

Definition: the general government sector (S.13) consists of institutional units which are non-market producers whose output is intended for individual and collective consumption, and are financed by compulsory payments made by units belonging to other sectors, and institutional units principally engaged in the redistribution of national income and wealth.

NAME: Graded rating system
DESCRIPTION: A Graded Rating system is a Rating system that assigns a Rating grade to a Party, Instrument or Debt security.

DESCRIPTION: A Security and exchange tradable derivative is a certificate attesting credit, the ownership of stocks or bonds, or the right to ownership connected with tradable derivatives.

DESCRIPTION: Security position hedged by Exchange tradable derivative position is the combination of a Long/short balance sheet recognised security position and an Exchange tradable derivative position as a hedge that indicates which (portion of a) Security position is hedged by which Exchange tradable derivative position as a hedge.

NAME: Security position
DESCRIPTION: A Security position is the combination of a Security and an Investor that indicates which Investor has invested in which Security.

NAME: Significant currency 10% depreciation contingent encumbrance
DESCRIPTION: Contingent encumbrance refers to the additional assets which may need to be encumbered when the reporting institutions faces adverse developments triggered by an external event over which the reporting institution has no control (including a downgrade, decrease of the fair value of the encumbered assets or a general loss of confidence). In these cases, the reporting institution will need to encumber additional assets as a consequence of already existing transactions. The additional amount of encumbered assets shall be net of the impact of the institution’s hedge transactions against the events described under the aforementioned stressed scenarios. (Annext 17 (Asset Encumbrance) 4. Part C)

NAME: Short balance sheet recognised security position national general accepted accounting principles (nGAAP) fiduciary item

DESCRIPTION: A Long  balance sheet recognised security position prudential portfolio assignment is the combination of a Long balance sheet recognised security position prudential portfolio assignment and a Prudential portfolio that indicates which security position is assigned to which Prudential portfolio.

NAME: Credit risk mitigation assignment
DESCRIPTION:
A credit risk mitigation membership is the combination of a Credit risk mitigation arrangement and a Protection item that indicates which Protection item is comprised in which Credit risk mitigation arrangement. 
Please note that the many-to-many relationship (established via this entity) is only applicable to Registered protection (and saving accounts where there exists a physical document (i.e. Sparbuch)), for all other Protection items the relationship between the Credit risk mitigation arrangement and the Protection item is of type one-to-many.

NAME: Credit transfer other than securitisation and covered bond programme
DESCRIPTION: A Credit transfer other than Securitisation and Covered bond programme is a Securitisation and other credit transfer that is not a Securitisation or a Covered bond programme.

DESCRIPTION:
‘Cash on hand’ shall include holdings of national and foreign banknotes and coins in circulation that are commonly used to make payments.
According to ESA 2010 this includes "Monetary gold", which is indicated via the currency "XAU". See ESA 2010 paragraph 5.65 - 5.68.

NAME: International securities identification number security

NAME: Security borrowing and lending transaction including cash as collateral component

NAME: Security collateral lending component Security collateral assignment
DESCRIPTION: Security collateral lending component Security assignment is the combination of the Security collateral ending component and the Security collateral that indicates which Security collateral has been lent out via the Security collateral  lending component.

NAME: Asset pool Non-balance sheet recognised security position assignment

NAME: Balance sheet netting
DESCRIPTION: A Balance sheet netting is the result of an operation in which financial Instruments are netted / off-set with each other for accounting purposes.

NAME: Balance sheet recognised/ Non-balance sheet recognised security position
DESCRIPTION: A Balance sheet/ non-balance security position is a security position that might be recognised or not in the balance sheet.

NAME: Credit facility
DESCRIPTION:
A Credit facility is a commitment (revocable or irrevocable) made by a financial institution to make an amount of money available to the customer (or a plurality of customers), or to assume for it an obligation to a third party. The commitment is based on an agreement between the financial institution and the customer, which originates from a request of the customer or an acceptance by the customer of a proposal from the financial institution.

Please note that the Credit facility is always off-balance sheet given.

NAME: Credit facility Entity role assignment
DESCRIPTION: A Credit facility Entity role assignment is the combination of a Credit facility and an Entity role that indicates which Entity role is assigned to which Credit facility.

NAME: Credit risk mitigation assignment
DESCRIPTION:
A credit risk mitigation membership is the combination of a Credit risk mitigation arrangement and a Protection item that indicates which Protection item is comprised in which Credit risk mitigation arrangement. 
Please note that the many-to-many relationship (established via this entity) is only applicable to Registered protection (and saving accounts where there exists a physical document (i.e. Sparbuch)), for all other Protection items the relationship between the Credit risk mitigation arrangement and the Protection item is of type one-to-many.

NAME: Central bank
DESCRIPTION:
Regulation (EU) 549/2013, 2.72:
Definition: the central bank subsector (S.121) consists of all financial corporations and quasi-corporations whose principal function is to issue currency, to maintain the internal and external value of the currency and to hold all or part of the international reserves of the country.

NAME: Central bank and private sector company
DESCRIPTION: An Central bank and private sector company is an Organisation that is not an International organisation or a General government.

NAME: Central bank and private sector company role
DESCRIPTION: A Central bank and private sector company role is a Central bank and private sector company acting in a specific role. Examples are Subsidiary, Joint venture or Associate.

NAME: Central counterparty client
DESCRIPTION: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision - Capital requirements for banks exposures to central counterparties (see https://www.bis.org/publ/bcbs227.pdf): A CCP client is a party to a transaction with a CCP through either a clearing member acting as a financial intermediary, or a clearing member guaranteeing the performance of the client to the CCP.

NAME: Central government
DESCRIPTION:
Regulation (EU) 549/2013, 2.114:
Definition: this subsector includes all administrative departments of the state and other central agencies whose competence extends normally over the whole economic territory, except for the administration of social security funds. Included in subsector S.1311 are those non-profit institutions which are controlled by central government and whose competence extends over the whole economic territory. Market regulatory organisations which are either exclusively or principally distributors of subsidies are classified in S.1311. Those organisations which are exclusively or principally engaged in buying, holding and selling agricultural or food products are classified in S.11.

NAME: Central government rating system

NAME: Credit card debt
DESCRIPTION: Credit card debt comprises credit granted to households or non-financial corporations either via delayed debit cards, i.e. cards providing convenience credit as defined below, or via credit cards, i.e. cards providing convenience credit and extended credit. Credit card debt is recorded on dedicated card accounts and therefore not evident on current or overdraft accounts. (Regulation (EU) 2021/379, Annex 2)

NAME: Risk position (Kb) per bucket derived data
DESCRIPTION:
The risk position for bucket b, K(b), must be determined by aggregating the weighted sensitivities to risk factors within the same bucket using the corresponding prescribed correlation ρ(kl)

KB per bucket is a term used in the standardised approach for market risk under FRTB. It is the risk capital requirement for a given bucket of risk factors within a risk class. It is computed as an aggregation of risk positions first at the bucket level, and then across buckets within a risk class defined for the sensitivities-based method.

A bucket is a set of risk factors that are grouped together by common characteristics (eg all tenors of interest rate curves for the same currency), as defined in MAR21.39 to MAR21.892. A risk position is the portion of the risk of an instrument that relates to a risk factor.

(https://www.bis.org/basel_framework/chapter/MAR/21.htm?inforce=20230101&published=20200327)

NAME: Rating agency
DESCRIPTION:
A (Credit) Rating agency is a credit rating agency that is registered or certified in accordance with Regulation (EC) No 1060/2009 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 16 September 2009 on credit rating agencies or a central bank issuing credit ratings which are exempt from the application of Regulation (EC) No 1060/2009.
A Rating agency can be either an Extern Credit Assessment Institution (ECAI) or an Export Credit Agency (ECA).
An export credit agency (known in trade finance as an ECA) or investment insurance agency is a private or quasi-governmental institution that acts as an intermediary between national governments and exporters to issue export insurance solutions, guarantees for financing. The financing can take the form of credits (financial support) or credit insurance and guarantees (pure cover) or both, depending on the mandate the ECA has been given by its government. ECAs can also offer credit or cover on their own account. This does not differ from normal banking activities. Some agencies are government-sponsored, others private, and others a combination of the two.

NAME: Master agreement with a clearing member

DESCRIPTION: A Master agreement with a non-qualifying central counterparty is a Master agreement with a central counterparty where the Central counterparty is a Non-qualifying central counterparty.

NAME: Master agreement with a qualifying central counterparty
DESCRIPTION: A Master agreement with a qualifying central counterparty is a Master agreement with a central counterparty where the Central counterparty is a Qualifying central counterparty.

NAME: Master netting counterparty
DESCRIPTION: A Master netting counterparty is a Organisation role where the Organisation is involved in a Master netting agreement.

NAME: Movable property
DESCRIPTION: Movable property is an investment property that is movable, including cars, airplanes, ships, industrial and mechanical equipment (machinery, mechanical and technical equipment), inventories and commodities (merchandise, finished and semi-finished products, raw materials) and other forms of movable property.

NAME: Non-fair-valued balance sheet recognised exchange tradable derivative liability position
DESCRIPTION: A Non-fair-valued balance sheet recognised exchange tradable derivative liability position is an Exchange tradable derivative position role which is not Fair valued.

NAME: Numeric rating system
DESCRIPTION: A Numeric rating system is a Rating system that assigns a (numeric) Probability of Default of a Party, Instrument or Debt security.

NAME: Non-balance sheet recognised debt security position
DESCRIPTION: A non-balance sheet recognised debt  security position is a debt security position that is not recognised in the balance sheet. A debt security position that is not recognised in the balance sheet is by default a long security position.

NAME: Guarantor Debt security assignment
DESCRIPTION:
A Guarantor Debt security assignment assignment is the combination of Guarantor and Debt security that indicates which Guarantor is providing the guarantee for which Debt security.

The guarantor is obliged to make payments to the holder of the security if the issuer fails to meet the obligation to make repayments arising under the instrument secured by the guarantor. Providers of a "financial guarantee", as defined in Annex V to Regulation (EU) No 680/2014, should be covered.
Protection may be provided by several guarantors, in which case only one of the guarantors is to be reported based on reasonable and risk-prudent considerations (e.g., subordination of liabilities, extent of the contribution to the joint protection).
If the attribute is not applicable to the security due to the unavailability of guarantees,the relevant NCB may dispense with the requirement to fill the attribute. (Guidance notes to reporting agents on SHS regulation)

NAME: Guarantor
DESCRIPTION: A Guarantor is a Party role where the Party is obliged to make payments to the holder of the security if the issuer fails to meet the obligation to make repayments arising under the instrument secured by the guarantor. Providers of a “financial guarantee”, as defined in Annex V to Regulation (EU) No 680/2014, should be covered.

NAME: Group of clients

NAME: Group of connected clients
DESCRIPTION: A Group of connected clients is a Group of clients that comprises Parties that are economically dependent on each other.

NAME: Group of consolidated clients
DESCRIPTION: A Group of consolidated clients is a Group of clients that combines account and balance data from multiple subsidiary client records into one master client record.

NAME: Group

NAME: Group Key management personnel assignment

NAME: Immediate parent enterprise
DESCRIPTION: Immediate parent enterprise is a Central bank and private sector company role that is the immediate parent of at least one Central bank and private sectore company via the Immediate parent enterprise assignment.

NAME: Immaterial rights as collateral
DESCRIPTION:
Immaterial rights as collateral is a Collateral that describe rights that are not financial and not material. 

An example of this are intellectual property rights.

DESCRIPTION: An Instrument Collateral assignment is the combination of an Instrument and a Collateral that indicates which Instrument is protected by which Collateral.

DESCRIPTION: An Instrument Collateral  instrument assignment is the combination of an Instrument and a Collateral received instrument or Collateral given instrument that indicates which Instrument is protected by which Collateral received instrument or which instrument is being protected by which Collateral given instrument.

Please note: 
- The overall information about the Debt security issued (by the reporting agent) is in the entity type Debt security.
- The asset side of the bought back and/or retained part of the Debt security issued (by the reporting agent) is in the entity type Long debt security position.

NAME: 30% Fair value decrease contingent encumbrance
DESCRIPTION: Contingent encumbrance refers to the additional assets which may need to be encumbered when the reporting institutions faces adverse developments triggered by an external event over which the reporting institution has no control (including a downgrade, decrease of the fair value of the encumbered assets or a general loss of confidence). In these cases, the reporting institution will need to encumber additional assets as a consequence of already existing transactions. The additional amount of encumbered assets shall be net of the impact of the institution’s hedge transactions against the events described under the aforementioned stressed scenarios. (Annext 17 (Asset Encumbrance) 4. Part C)

NAME: Security lending component Security assignment
DESCRIPTION: Security lending component Security assignment is the combination of the Security lending component and the Security that indicates which Security has been lent out via the Security lending component.

NAME: Security position
DESCRIPTION: A Security position is the combination of a Security and an Investor that indicates which Investor has invested in which Security.

NAME: Security position hedged by Over the counter (OTC) derivative
DESCRIPTION: A Security position hedged by Over the counter (OTC) derivative is the combination of a Long/Short balance sheet recognised security position and an Over the counter (OTC) derivative as a hedge that indicates which (portion of a Long/short balance sheet recognised security position is hedged by which Over the counter (OTC) derivative (acting in the role of an Over the counter (OTC) derivative as a hedge).

NAME: Significant currency 10% depreciation contingent encumbrance
DESCRIPTION: Contingent encumbrance refers to the additional assets which may need to be encumbered when the reporting institutions faces adverse developments triggered by an external event over which the reporting institution has no control (including a downgrade, decrease of the fair value of the encumbered assets or a general loss of confidence). In these cases, the reporting institution will need to encumber additional assets as a consequence of already existing transactions. The additional amount of encumbered assets shall be net of the impact of the institution’s hedge transactions against the events described under the aforementioned stressed scenarios. (Annext 17 (Asset Encumbrance) 4. Part C)

NAME: Over the counter (OTC) Derivative instrument Synthetic securitisation assignment
DESCRIPTION: Over the counter (OTC) Derivative instrument Synthetic securitisation assignment is the combination of Over the counter (OTC) Derivative instrument and Synthetic securitisation assignment that indicates which Over the counter (OTC) Derivative instrument is assigned to which Synthetic securitisation assignment.

NAME: Other party identifier
DESCRIPTION: Other party identifier is a code (different to the attribute Party identifier) of a Party that identifies the party in systems outside of the bank. It is a combination of a Party and a Party  identifier type.

NAME: Property plant and equipment taken into possession
DESCRIPTION: Property plant and equipment taken into possession is Property plant and equipment that was not pledged by the debtor as collateral, but was obtained in exchange for the cancellation of debt, whether on a voluntary basis or as part of legal proceedings.

NAME: Protection arrangement
DESCRIPTION: A Protection arrangement is an Arrangement that mitigates the credit risk that may arise from Contracts.

NAME: Protection arrangement role
DESCRIPTION: A Protection arrangement role is a role the Protection arrangement may act in.

NAME: Protection Protection provider assignment
DESCRIPTION: A Protection Protection provider assignment is the composition of a Protection arrangement and a Protection provider that indicates which Protection provider provides which Protection.

NAME: Partner enterprise assignment
DESCRIPTION: Partner enterprise assignment is the combination of a Central bank and private sector company and a Parent enterprise that indicates which Central bank and private sector company is a partner to which Central bank and private sector company in the sense of Commission Recommendation 2003/361/EC.

NAME: Party code
DESCRIPTION: A party code is a code (different to the Party identifier) of a Party that identifies the party in systems outside of the bank. It is a combination of a Party and a Party code identifier.

NAME: Party
DESCRIPTION: A Party is an entity of interest.

NAME: Party previous period data
DESCRIPTION: A Party previous period data is information about a Party associated with the previous period. For example the Enterprise size that was calculated in the previous period.

NAME: Provisions associated with credit facility
DESCRIPTION: Provision associated with credit facility is provisions related to all commitments and guarantees, irrespective of whether their impairment is determined in accordance with IFRS 9 or their provisioning follows IAS 37 or whether they are treated as insurance contracts under IFRS 4. Under national GAAP based on BAD, provisions for ‘Commitments and guarantees given’ shall include provisions related to all commitments and guarantees.

NAME: Provisions associated with off-balance sheet item given
DESCRIPTION: Provision associated with off-balance sheet item given instrument is provisions related to all commitments and guarantees, irrespective of whether their impairment is determined in accordance with IFRS 9 or their provisioning follows IAS 37 or whether they are treated as insurance contracts under IFRS 4. Under national GAAP based on BAD, provisions for ‘Commitments and guarantees given’ shall include provisions related to all commitments and guarantees.

NAME: Repurchase transaction gold (given) assignment
DESCRIPTION: Repurchase transaction gold assignment is the combination of a Repurchase transaction (being a repurchase agreement) and Gold that is given in the repurchase transaction.

NAME: Long balance sheet recognised security position prudential portfolio Accounting classification assignment taken into possession
DESCRIPTION: A Long balance sheet recognised security position prudential portfolio Accounting classification assignment taken into possession is a  Long balance sheet recognised security position that was not pledged by the debtor as collateral, but was obtained in exchange for the cancellation of debt, whether on a voluntary basis or as part of legal proceeding

NAME: Long balance sheet recognised security position prudential portfolio assignment
DESCRIPTION: A Long  balance sheet recognised security position prudential portfolio assignment is the combination of a Long balance sheet recognised security position prudential portfolio assignment and a Prudential portfolio that indicates which security position is assigned to which Prudential portfolio.

NAME: Long balance sheet recognised security position prudential portfolio assignment risk data
DESCRIPTION: A Long balance sheet recognised security position risk data is risk related information about a Long balance sheet recognised debt security position.

NAME: Long balance sheet recognised security position protection arrangement received assignment
DESCRIPTION: Long balance sheet recognised security position Protection arrangement received assignment is the combination of Long balance sheet recognised security position Protection arrangement received and Protection arrangement received stating which Long balance sheet recognised security position is protected by which Protection arrangement.

NAME: Long non-balance sheet recognised security position collateral received assigment
DESCRIPTION: Long non-balance sheet recognised security position collateral received assigment is the combination of Long non- balance sheet recognised security position and collateral received stating which Long non- balance sheet recognised security position is protected by which Collateral.

NAME: Long non-balance sheet recognised security position protection arrangement received assignment
DESCRIPTION: Long non-balance sheet recognised security position Protection arrangement received assignment is the combination of Long non-balance sheet recognised security position Protection arrangement received and Protection arrangement received stating which Long non-balance sheet recognised security position is protected by which Protection arrangement.

NAME: Long/Short balance sheet recognised security position
DESCRIPTION: A Long/Short balance sheet recognised security position is a balance sheet recognised security position that is either long or short.

NAME: Long/Short balance sheet recognised security position as a hedge
DESCRIPTION: Long/Short balance sheet recognised security position as a hedge is the role in which the Security position role acts as a hedge.

NAME: Linked enterprise assignment
DESCRIPTION: A Linked enterprise is a combination of a Central bank and private sector company and a Central bank and private sector company that indicates which Central bank and private sector company is linked to which Central bank and private sector company in the sense of Commission Recommendation 2003/361/EC.

NAME: Loan and advance as a hedge
DESCRIPTION: Loan and advance as a hedge is a Loan and advance role where the Loan  and advance instrument acts as a non-derivative hedge.

NAME: Master agreement
DESCRIPTION: A Master agreement is an arrangement that bundles Financial contacts and / or Protection arrangements.

NAME: 30% Fair value decrease contingent encumbrance

In these cases, the reporting institution will need to encumber additional assets as a consequence of already existing transactions. NAME: Debt security issued (by the reporting agent) derived data
DESCRIPTION: Debt security issued (by the reporting agent) derived data is extra information about Debt security issued (by the reporting agent) that can be derived from other information in the model.

NAME: Debt security issued (by the reporting agent)
DESCRIPTION:
A Debt security issued (by the Reporting agent) is the combination of the  Debt security where the Reporting agent is the Debtor and the accounting classification that represents the financial liability side of the Debt security issued (by the reporting agent).

Please note: 
- The overall information about the Debt security issued (by the reporting agent) is in the entity type Debt security.
- The asset side of the bought back and/or retained part of the Debt security issued (by the reporting agent) is in the entity type Long debt security position.

NAME: Debt security issued (by the reporting agent) as a hedge
DESCRIPTION: Debt security issued (by the reporting agent) as a hedge is a Debt security issued (by the reporting agent) role where the Debt security issued (by the reporting agent) acts in the role of a non-derivative hedge.

NAME: Debt security issued (by the reporting agent) Protection arrangement given assignment
DESCRIPTION: Debt security issued (by the reporting agent) Protection arrangement assignment is the combination of Debt security issued and Protection arrangement stating which Debt security issued is protected by which Protection arrangement.

NAME: Issued debt security in the trading book
DESCRIPTION: Issued debt security in the trading book is a Debt security issued (by the reporting agent) that are on the trading book.

NAME: Issued debt security in the trading book International Financial Reporting Standard (IFRS)
DESCRIPTION: Issued debt security in the trading book International Financial Reporting Standard (IFRS) is an Issued debt security in the trading book where the applicable accountin standard is IFRS.

NAME: Issued debt security in the trading book national general accepted accounting principles (nGAAP)
DESCRIPTION: Issued debt security in the trading book national general accepted accounting principles (nGAAP) is an Issued debt security in the trading book where the applicable accounting standard is nGAAP.

NAME: Debt security issued (by the reporting agent) Traditional securitisation assignment
DESCRIPTION: Debt security issued (by the reporting agent) Traditional securitisation assignment is the combination of Debt security issued (by the reporting agent) and Traditional securitisation assignment that indicates which Debt security issued (by the reporting agent) is assigned to which Traditional securitisation assignment.

NAME: Debt security for national general accepted accounting principles (nGAAP)
DESCRIPTION: Debt security for national general accepted accounting principles (nGAAP) is a Debt security where the figures are applicable only to nGAAP.

NAME: Debt security position hedged by Over the counter (OTC) derivative
DESCRIPTION: A Debt security position hedged by Over the counter (OTC) derivative is a Security position hedged by Over the counter (OTC) derivative where the Security is a Debt security.

NAME: Debt security without underlying assets
DESCRIPTION: A Debt security without underlying assets is a Debt security that is not linked to underlying assets.

NAME: Debt security with underlying assets
DESCRIPTION: A Debt security with underlying assets is a Debt security where the cash flow of the Debt security is dependent on the cash flow of the underlying assets.

NAME: Default financial asset instrument individually assessed
DESCRIPTION:
A Default financial asset instrument individually assessed is a Financial asset instrument individually assessed that is in default according to Regulation (EU) 575/2013, Article 178 Obligor in default.
Regulation (EU) 575/2013, Article 178 Default of an obligor:
"In the case of retail exposures, institutions may apply the definition of default laid down in points (a) and (b) of the first subparagraph at the level of an individual credit facility rather than in relation to the total obligations of a borrower.".

NAME: Deferred tax asset
DESCRIPTION: A Deferred tax asset is a Tax asset according to Accounting Directive art 17(1)(f); CRR art 4(1)(106)for IFRS: IAS 1.54(o); IAS 12.5; CRR art 4(1)(106) (for for nGaap).

NAME: Non-balance sheet recognised financial liability instrument according to International Financial Reporting Standard (IFRS)
DESCRIPTION: Non-balance sheet recognised financial liability instrument according to International Financial Reporting Standard (IFRS) is a Non-balance sheet recognised financial liability instrument where the applicable accounting standard in IFRS.

NAME: Non-balance sheet recognised financial liability instrument according to national general accepted accounting principles (nGAAP)
DESCRIPTION: Non-Balance sheet recognised financial liability instrument according to national general accepted accounting principles (nGAAP) is a Non-Balance sheet recognised financial liability instrument where the applicable accounting standard in national GAAP.
